answer.explanation: The live Thumbnailer configuration has MemorySize 128 MB and Timeout 3 s. The IaC template, which is the intended state, specifies MemorySize 1024 and Timeout 30. The live config was last modified at 20:31:15Z, one second before the window opened, so the drift is in effect for the whole window. The Thumbnailer's REPORT lines in the window confirm 128 MB, with durations of roughly 380–740 ms, so the 3 s timeout is close to the observed latency and at risk of timeouts. No IAM or code change is implicated. The other three functions match the template.
